Harlan County Births from 1911-1920

Each listing includes childs names, date of birth, mothers name,
volume number, volume year and certificate number.

To obtain a copy of the birth record you can visit the Kentucky Vital Records
web site and order online or through regular mail.
Follow the instructions given on their website for the information you
need to include when ordering a copy of a birth certificate.
